text:
elaine: Hey team — quick ask: can we run a smoke parity run on customer-onprem-01 (VPC-like net) to validate perf after the kernel tweak? Need numbers and a flamegraph by EOD. cc @sam @mitya

sam: I can do a quick bench. Which binary branch? main or onprem-parity-rc1?

elaine: use onprem-parity-rc1; it includes the batching fix. Also please use MTU 9000 and enable prefetch kernel param we talked about.

devops-bot: Deploy job started: deploy/onprem-parity-rc1 -> customer-onprem-01 by sam (job id: dpl-8912). Logs: https://ci.redwood/test/dpl-8912

alex: FYI I pushed a tiny config change for net.ipv4.tcp_mtu_probing=1 — PR 4321. @sam can you include that in the run?

sam: picking up PR 4321. Kicked off bench run with throughput profile 'low-latency'. ETA ~20m.

mitya: quick heads-up: last time enabling MTU 9000 on that box required reconfiguring the bridge, else drops. I'll watch the NIC stats.

sam: results (raw):  p50=18ms p95=46ms p99=110ms tokens/s=220. Baseline (main) was p50=32ms p95=78ms tokens/s=160. So pretty decent uplift. uploading artifacts...

devops-bot: Artifacts uploaded: https://ci.redwood/artifacts/dpl-8912/bench-1795001234.tar.gz

priya: Nice! Can we also get a CPU flamegraph and kv-cache heatmap? If possible run a 30s perf record: perf record -F 99 -a -g -- sleep 30 and generate flamegraph.

sam: on it. Adding perf record and flamegraph. Will include flamegraph.svg in the artifact.

mitya: observed occasional tail latency spikes correlated with CPU steal (~0.5%) when background backups kicked. Might need an affinity pin for the runtime worker threads.

elaine: good catch. @sam add numa pinning config: --affinity=worker:cpu-cores 2-5 for the follow-up run. Also open a small CR for the affinity change so infra can review.

sam: created CR 5678 with the affinity flag. pinging @alex and @priya for review.

alex: reviewing CR 5678 now. left 1 comment about a fallback to no-pin mode.

priya: LGTM once tests pass. Also can you add a short note in the run artifact README about MTU/bridge changes? ops may need it.

sam: will add README and re-run nightly. Thanks all :tada:
